mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 77 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park, perfect for stargazing with a third quarter moon. If you are up early, look to the west-northwest over Cross Plains around 5:08 AM to see the International Space Station traveling high across the sky toward Oregon.

The City of Verona is moving forward with the Military Ridge State Trail paving project to ensure year-round accessibility, with bridge replacements expected to start this summer. Also, make sure to visit Century School Park to see the newly installed Tai Chi Animal Frolics public art sculpture.

We have a full slate of activities starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmer's Market at the Capitol Square or catch some tunes at Paddy Mac's.
The Verona Police Department reported a variety of incidents last week, including a specific case involving medical emergencies that occurred last Monday.
Culver's of Verona is serving up the delicious Chocolate Volcano as today's flavor. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by before they close at 10:30 PM.
